profile.headline: Senior Lead Software Engineer @ Capital One | Full-Stack Development
profile.summary: I am a Senior Lead Full Stack Software Engineer specializing in designing and developing web applications. I'm passionate about innovation, open source, and solving problems! OMSCS graduate from Georgia Tech. Amateur content creator for technical topics. Read some of my articles at https://medium.com/@rich-w-lee!

positions.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Senior Individual Contributor for Enterprise Case Management Platform, responsible for designing and leading projects spanning 10+ teams.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Horizontal individual contributor, working with 3+ teams to support designing and implementing features.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Technical Lead for full stack team requiring leading or architectural designs and decisions, guiding fellow developers and resolving technical impediments as need
• Created Code Standards and Best Practices for a project that has 50+ contributors and over 250 monthly contributions
• Work with contributing teams to prioritize and design business critical features
• Developed a serverless POC for a micro-frontend application with a UI and orchestration layer running on AWS S3 and Lambda
• Re-certified for the AWS Solutions Architect certification

positions.title: General Manager & Lead Technician
positions.description:
- Oversaw all 4 stores in the Richmond area while directly managing one
- In charge of daily intake of mobile repairs and ensuring exceptional customer service and repair quality from all technicians.
- Responsible for performing most difficult and skilled repairs such as micro-soldering and water damage repairs
- Purchase required parts, tools, and materials on a regular basis from national and international suppliers
- Train new and current technicians to ensure a rich depth of repair knowledge and skills across the company

positions.title: President
positions.description:
- Oversee over 500 fraternity men in 15 different fraternities
- Coordinate with Fraternity & Sorority Life Office as well as other Greek Councils
- Plan and run weekly general body meetings.

certifications.name: Amazon Web Services Solutions Architect Associate
certifications.title: Amazon Web Services Solutions Architect Associate

volunteerExperiences.description: Capital One has a program called “CODERS” where middle school students in low-income schools are given the chance to learn about programming. As a mentor, I coached the students from start to finish of developing several mobile apps using MIT AppInventor
